summary: A mixed (indeterminate) Checkbox now has a hover: its edge firms from --ui-border-strong to --ui-text-primary, the dash's own ink — the same one-step firming an unchecked box gets (control → strong). Closes the Audit #9 "Missing" row (Paper, Components - Handoff). DERIVED, like every Checkbox hover. The sheet's suggested --ui-bg-hover fill was measured and rejected: it equals --ui-bg-sunken in light (1.00:1) and sits below it in dark, so the box would have receded on hover in one scheme only. Browser test added.
